instruction: Please help me recover the deleted poster file from Trash and restore it to the home directory.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command: [ -f /home/user/poster_party_night.webp ] && echo 'File exists.' || echo 'File does not exist.'
